head: 8c952af20fe791cc0c5d0a59089d3329968b4373

source.ref: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/3212; hand-checked 2026-09-28 and 2026-09-29; both fixed by 16d10d78e in the same pull request

rationale: Removing a request field and a profile field leaves tests that still set or omit them, a compile failure in the test targets that AACR-Bench's references do not name. The same change stops serializing a reasoning item's id that deserializing still requires, so resumed sessions drop their reasoning; two AACR-Bench references, both written by models, point at that field without stating the round trip. ADR-0036: the test compile failure is optional, since rustc reports it (E0063) and the reviewers are told to leave that to the compiler; base set to the merge base.

expect.concern: ResponsesApiRequest still declares store, but the test initializers had store removed, so the core unit tests fail to compile with a missing field.
Reasoning's id is now skipped when serializing but still required when deserializing, so every reasoning item the rollout recorder writes fails to parse on resume and is dropped with only a warning.
